newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta seeds 75 pct of crops as rain, snow fall.
newsitem.headline: Alberta seeds 75 pct of crops as rain, snow fall.

text.p: Alberta spring seeding was near complete in the south while the north was delayed by rain and snow, Alberta Agriculture's crop report for the week ended May 20 said.
The Canadian Wheat Board said seeding was 75 percent complete across Alberta by May 20.

Southern Alberta's emerging crops faced drought stress in the past week's hot, windy weather. Much of the region's crops were seeded with a few producers waiting for better soil moisture conditions before planting remaining canola crops.
Central Alberta seeded 75 to 90 percent of its crops.
Northeast Alberta's harvest of crops left from last fall was almost completed with only Plamondon and Wandering River left to combine. Spring seeding was 20 to 50 percent done.

Northwest Alberta saw seeding progress stalled by rain with Boyle-Athabasca crop district with as little as five percent of acreage planted while the remainder of the region was 30 to 75 percent done.
Peace River Valley seeding was 15 to 50 percent complete but progress was expected to be stalled due to rain and snow this week.
